frequency_arithmetic.derivation: $250 / ($10 per trade) = 25 executed trades per year under full 1R realized risk

frequency_arithmetic.note: assumes every executed trade earns exactly the MME and ignores compounding, idle capital and p_exec < 1, each of which raises the requirement; when the $2,500 notional cap binds below 4% stops the required count rises to 50-100 (stage2p/GATE0_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.md section 7)
